name: Cham performances
nameVi: Biểu diễn văn hóa dân gian Chăm
kicker: Daytime Cham dance and singing in the valley
summary: Time the morning for the hall, or for the show at the foot of group G, the Italian restoration. The 2020 guide includes a folk performance in the entrance ticket. The ticket information page prints the clock and does not repeat that sentence. Bad weather can stop the group G show. The evening show has no fixed date. Skip it if you only came for the brick.
dotReason: Worth timing if you are already in the valley, not a separate trip
timeNeeded: One slot inside the visit. The length of a show is check on arrival.
getThere: In the valley after the cart. 45 km by road from Hoi An. The minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Cham dancers at a performance in My Son

notice.title: The evening show has no fixed date
notice.body: Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại plays inside the grounds, with sound and light. On 1 Dec 2025 the deputy in charge said the calendar is not fixed and follows dates when large groups are present. Do not stay for a night you have not confirmed.

body: The daytime clock is three places, on the same ticket as the towers. The hall runs at 09:45, 10:30, 11:15, 14:00, and 16:00, every day unless the board cancels for operations. At the foot of group G the show is 09:00 and 14:45, and bad weather can stop that one. Group G is the Italian restoration. A 25 Feb 2025 essay says Italian experts surveyed the valley from 1997 to 2000, and that Italy funded the work there with UNESCO’s backing. A conservation note from the day before says that group also uses laterite. Cham folk singing is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at the group H slope, at those same two hours.

On the 15th, Echoes of My Son is the program in groups B, C, and D. The 2019 hours notice and the ticket information page put it at 09:00 and 14:45. A note dated 13 Jul 2026, from the Culture and Arts office, also puts the program on the 15th, and names the ginang and paranung drums, the saranai, a fan dance, a water-carrying dance, and Cham folk song. That note does not print the hours. The 2020 guide says the entrance ticket includes a folk performance. The ticket information page prints the clock and does not repeat that sentence. Ask before you count on the monthly show.

Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại is the evening show, inside the monument grounds, with sound and light. Tuổi Trẻ, quoting the deputy in charge on 1 Dec 2025, describes three parts: Thung lũng câu chuyện thời gian, Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại, and Ánh sáng chan hòa. He said the calendar is not fixed. Do not plan a night from the 2022 lunar notice. There is no food in the monument area. Sleep in Hoi An.

figures.caption: Group G, where the 09:00 and 14:45 show is held

gettingThere: The hall, group G, and the group H slope are in the valley, after the cart. Cars stop at the museum. The cart covers about 2 km along the Khe Thẻ stream, and that ride is inside the entrance ticket on the 2019 service note and the 2020 guide. Tourism bus 01DL, from Hoi An, is paused for six months from 15 Sep 2026.

legs.heading: From Hoi An
legs.body: By road to the museum, then the cart. The sanctuary prints 45 km and no drive time. The minutes are check on arrival. Bus 01DL is paused from 15 Sep 2026 for six months.

legs.heading: From the museum
legs.body: The electric cart runs about 2 km toward the towers. The 10 Mar 2025 board note still has those carts as the daily vehicle, from the museum toward the Nhà Đôi area. The hall and group G are in that valley.

hours: Hall at 09:45, 10:30, 11:15, 14:00, and 16:00. Group G at 09:00 and 14:45. Cham folk singing at the group H slope at 09:00 and 14:45 on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. The gate opens at 06:00. A show length is not published. Check on arrival.
closed: The hall is every day unless the board cancels for operations. Bad weather can stop the show at group G. Singing at the group H slope is only Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. The evening show has no published night.
admissionNote: No separate daytime-show price is printed. The 2020 guide says the entrance ticket includes a Cham folk performance, with the museum, the cart, and the monuments. The information page, the 2019 price notice, and the 2026 city list print non-resident adult 150,000 VND and Vietnamese adult 100,000 VND. The information page says that price includes VAT and does not repeat the word included. On 21 Oct 2026 the purchase page showed 148,000 VND and 99,000 VND. Read the amount before you pay. Children are not one rule. Check the child fare on arrival. Whether Echoes of My Son on the 15th, and whether Đêm Mỹ Sơn huyền thoại, sit inside that ticket is check on arrival. The evening show has no 2026 price on the pages checked, and no fixed night.
